title: Provider Call Center Policy Assistant
problem_statement: Call center agents spend minutes searching provider manuals and billing rules to answer provider inquiries about claim denials and timely filing, causing long hold times and call abandonment.
current_process: Agents search PDF provider manuals and a shared FAQ, then escalate to Tier 2 when unsure.
desired_outcome: Assist agents with cited answers in seconds to improve first-contact resolution and reduce abandon rate.

title: Provider Enrollment Document Intelligence
problem_statement: Enrollment specialists manually re-key data from uploaded licenses, W-9 forms and ownership disclosures into the MMIS provider enrollment record, creating a backlog during revalidation cycles.
current_process: Specialists open each PDF attachment, compare it to the portal application, and key fields by hand.
desired_outcome: Extract and pre-populate fields so specialists only verify, reducing backlog and turnaround time.

title: Pended Claims Triage and Routing
problem_statement: Pended claims sit in a single queue; examiners pick work manually, so high-dollar and timely-filing-risk claims age past SLA.
current_process: Examiners filter a spreadsheet export of the pend queue and self-assign.
desired_outcome: Prioritize and route pended claims by edit type, dollar value and SLA risk so examiners work the right claims first.

title: Prior Authorization Clinical Summary
problem_statement: Nurse reviewers read long faxed medical records to determine medical necessity for prior auth requests.
current_process: Faxes are scanned to PDF; nurses read every page and summarize against criteria.
desired_outcome: Summarize relevant clinical notes against criteria to assist reviewers and meet turnaround SLAs.

title: Weekly Status Report Drafting
problem_statement: Project leads manually copy status updates from Jira into a weekly client report.
current_process: Copy and paste from tickets into a Word template.
desired_outcome: Draft the report automatically for lead review.
